dcterms:description: Omniglot is a character image dataset containing 1623 handwritten characters from 50 alphabets. Each character contains 20 gray images drawn by different writers. The dataset is used for few-shot learning tasks.
dcterms:title: Omniglot

dcterms:description: miniImageNet is a downsampled image subset of the large-scale ImageNet dataset. It consists of 100 classes with 600 RGB images of size 84 × 84 per class, used for few-shot learning tasks.
dcterms:title: miniImageNet
